name: attendance
_note: A plain weekly rotation. 'anchor' is any Monday; week 0 is Alex, week 1 Blake, and so on, wrapping forever. Copy this to rotations.json and put your own names in.
_overrides_note: One-off changes for a single week, e.g. someone is away. The key is any date inside the week to change; it beats the normal cycle. A value may be a plain name or { lead, shadow }. The pair here shows the usual case: Drew and Erin swap weeks, so every week still has someone and nobody lands twice running. Delete entries once the week has passed.

name: sound
_note: 'sequence' is an optional opening run of weeks, useful for a training phase: experienced people lead while newcomers shadow. Once it is used up, the rotation falls back to cycling through 'members'.
